claim_text: Before adding zinc gluconate or another zinc product, reconcile total elemental zinc from all current products; chronic excessive intake can cause copper deficiency and zinc can interact with certain medicines.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent duplicate supplementation and unsupported wellness claims; support safe total-intake assessment.

population.other_context: People already using zinc supplements or multivitamins.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify exact product label and formulation.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Zinc fact sheet describes elemental zinc, upper limits, copper effects and medicine interactions.
limitations: No additional dose from this claim; distinguish compound mass from elemental zinc.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
